title: A Generalization of $Δ$U Rings
summary: In this paper, we introduce and study a new class of rings calling them {\it weakly $ΔU$-rings}, hereafter abbreviated as {\it $WΔU$-rings} for short. A ring $R$ is said to be $WΔU$ if every unit of $R$ can be expressed as $\pm 1 + d$ for some $d \in Δ(R)$, where $Δ(R)$ is the largest Jacobson radical of $R$ that is closed under multiplication by units. Utilizing the known structure of $Δ(R)$, we investigate the relationships between $WΔU$ rings and certain classical concepts such as $ΔU$-rings, $UJ$-rings, $WUJ$-rings, as well as clean and exchange rings.
